title: Residual PRNG Synthetic Bootstrap Contamination, Confidence Score Inversion, and Outlier-into-Fraud Conflation in realMarketPriceAggregator.ts
observed_condition: In aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics (lines 260-275): (1) When observedEvaluated.length < 3 (isBootstrapped === true), seededRandom(hoodId * 997 + Math.floor(Date.now() / 86_400_000)) generates 12 synthetic listings (syntheticRaw) that populate evaluated; (2) sampleCount and validSampleCount return 12 even when observedSampleCount is 0, 1, or 2; (3) confidenceScore is hardcoded to 74 when isBootstrapped is true, which is higher than confidenceScore = 71 when 3 real observed listings are supplied (62 + 3*3 = 71); (4) iqrLowPerSqm and iqrHighPerSqm (131.3 - 154.3 in Punak) are computed from the 12 synthetic PRNG rows and displayed in NeighborhoodInspectorTabs.tsx:201 and ProductIntelligenceView.tsx:182 as the neighborhood's valid statistical range; (5) synthetic 'boot-*' listings are appended to autoBargains; (6) line 253 flags rawPerSqm < 0.42x or > 2.4x as isPredatoryAnomaly -> suspectedFraudCount -> fraudReviewState: 'FRAUD_SUSPECTED' from price ratio alone; and (7) line 271 computes rejectedFraudCount = excludedOutlierCount + suspectedFraudCount, adding statistical IQR outliers directly into rejectedFraudCount.
expected_condition: Zero or sparse (<3) observed samples must never fabricate 12 synthetic PRNG listings to populate sampleCount, validSampleCount, iqrLowPerSqm, iqrHighPerSqm, or autoBargains; confidence/evidence scores must be monotonically non-decreasing with real sample count; and statistical price outliers must never be summed into rejectedFraudCount or labeled FRAUD_SUSPECTED without multi-signal fraud evidence.
impact: Violates Missing-Data Transparency (0 samples has higher confidenceScore 74 than 3 real samples at 71), exposes time-dependent PRNG numbers as statistical IQR bounds in the UI, and conflates statistical outliers with rejected fraud counts.
recommended_action: Remove syntheticRaw PRNG generation from aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics when observedEvaluated.length < 3, return null or explicit baseline-only bounds when N < 3, fix confidenceScore monotonicity, and separate excludedOutlierCount from rejectedFraudCount and fraudReviewState.
verification_method: Direct code inspection (lines 228-275) and runtime execution via npx tsx comparing N=0, N=2, and N=3 outputs.

title: ProductIntelligenceView and CompareModal Pass Hardcoded Empty Array [] to aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics and Retain Authoritative Transaction Labels
observed_condition: NeighborhoodInspectorDrawer.tsx (lines 20-29) maps hood.bargains into aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics, producing observedSampleCount = 2 and evidenceIndexScore = 52 for Punak (hood=5). However, ProductIntelligenceView.tsx (lines 47 and 231) and CompareModal.tsx (line 8) call aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics(..., []) with a hardcoded empty array. As verified in Playwright at http://localhost:3000/?hood=5&view=intelligence and ?hood=5&compare=5-14, Punak simultaneously shows 'تخمین ترکیبی (نمونه محدود: ۲ آگهی)' in the Inspector Drawer and 'پروفایل مرجع (۰ آگهی مستقیم)' / '۰ آگهی' in ProductIntelligenceView and CompareModal. Additionally, ProductIntelligenceView.tsx still uses authoritative closing-transaction wording at line 65 ('تخمین قیمت قطعی معاملات (مدل v6.4)'), line 116 ('همگرایی قیمت اعلامی با نرخ معامله'), and line 191 ('جایگاه معامله قطعی: صدک ...').
expected_condition: All views consuming aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics for a neighborhood must pass the same mapped hood.bargains sample array so sample counts and epistemic badges are consistent across views, and ProductIntelligenceView must not label heuristic asking-price adjustments as confirmed closing transactions.
impact: Creates a visible cross-component contradiction on the same screen (2 observed listings in Drawer vs 0 in Intelligence View and Compare Modal) and misrepresents heuristic deal estimates as confirmed transaction prices.
recommended_action: Pass mapped hood.bargains into aggregateNeighborhoodMarketMetrics in ProductIntelligenceView.tsx (lines 47, 231) and CompareModal.tsx (line 8), and replace closing-transaction labels at ProductIntelligenceView.tsx lines 65, 116, and 191 with scenario-based asking-discount terminology.
verification_method: Static source inspection and live Playwright browser inspection at http://localhost:3000/?hood=5&compare=5-14 and http://localhost:3000/?hood=5&view=intelligence.

title: Silent Imputation of Missing Area (85 sqm) in Listing Parser and Silent Clamping of Invalid Inputs in Hedonic Engine
observed_condition: (1) In extractListingSpecsFromText (line 137), sqm is initialized to 'let sqm = 85'. When listings omit meterage in their description (e.g., { askingTotalMillion: 14000, description: 'آپارتمان خوش نقشه در پونک' }), specs.sqm silently defaults to 85, passing 'specs.sqm > 20' at line 251 with malformedSampleCount = 0 and computing a fabricated per-sqm price (14000 / 85 = 164.7M/sqm, normalized to 183.2M/sqm). (2) In calculateHedonicValuation (lines 97-100), passing sqm: 0 or sqm: -50 silently clamps safeSqm to 30 and returns a valid valuation (4,446M Toman), passing sqm: NaN silently defaults to 85 sqm (12,121M Toman), and passing floor: 20 in a 4-floor building applies a +10.5% high-rise bonus without validating floor <= totalFloors.
expected_condition: Missing required measurements (such as property area in a listing or invalid <=0/NaN area in valuation) must be explicitly flagged as malformed/invalid rather than silently substituted with 85 sqm or 30 sqm.
impact: Violates Provenance Invariant 1 & Section 20.3 and Advanced Acceptance Gate 4 ('Invalid or missing inputs silently generate apparently valid valuation results').
recommended_action: Track whether sqm was explicitly extracted in extractListingSpecsFromText (rejecting listings with missing sqm in evalSample as malformedSampleCount++), and validate sqm > 0 and floor <= totalFloors in calculateHedonicValuation.
verification_method: Adversarial runtime probe via npx tsx testing zero/negative/NaN sqm, floor > totalFloors, and descriptions without meterage.
